title: PPO improves judged summary preference, with important length-bias caveats

report.originalQuestion: What were the final results of the RTX 3090 reproduction of Learning to Summarize from Human Feedback?

source.label: Measured full-run training logs
filters: Formal full profile, random seed 42, single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 24GB

metricDefinitions.label: Wall time
metricDefinitions.definition: Elapsed stage runtime recorded by the training script, including final evaluation and artifact saving performed inside that stage.

metricDefinitions.label: Peak allocated GPU memory
metricDefinitions.definition: Maximum CUDA bytes actively allocated by PyTorch during the stage, divided by 2^30.

metricDefinitions.label: Peak reserved GPU memory
metricDefinitions.definition: Maximum CUDA bytes reserved by the PyTorch allocator during the stage, divided by 2^30.

evidenceFlow.title: Source
evidenceFlow.detail: Stage summaries are the final JSON objects emitted by the SFT, RM, and PPO scripts in logs/full.

metricDefinitions.label: Preference accuracy
metricDefinitions.definition: Share of human-labeled comparison pairs for which the reward model scores the chosen summary above the rejected summary.

metricDefinitions.label: Grouped 95% confidence interval
metricDefinitions.definition: Bootstrap confidence interval resampled by source post so comparisons from the same post remain grouped.

metricDefinitions.label: Reward-length correlation
metricDefinitions.definition: Pearson correlation between chosen-minus-rejected reward and chosen-minus-rejected candidate length.

automatic_metrics.label: Automatic metrics on the fixed 500-post test set

source.label: Generated-summary automatic metrics
filters: Same 500 held-out posts and generation settings for Base, SFT, and PPO

metricDefinitions.label: ROUGE-L
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean ROUGE-L F1 against the reference TL;DR summaries across the fixed test set.

metricDefinitions.label: 3-gram repetition
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean share of generated 3-grams that repeat within each summary; lower is better.

metricDefinitions.label: EOS rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Share of summaries that emitted EOS before reaching the configured generation limit.

source.label: Qwen3-Max blind pairwise judge summary
filters: Judge: qwen3-max-2026-01-23, Beijing endpoint, temperature 0, thinking disabled
Two A/B orders per post; ties score 0.5
assumptions: Qwen judge preference is not human preference and cannot be compared directly with the paper's human-evaluation values.
Fourteen of 3,000 unique judgments were blocked by provider content filtering; pair statistics use complete two-order post groups only.

metricDefinitions.label: Target preference score
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean post-level preference for the target model after averaging both A/B orders; a tie contributes 0.5.

metricDefinitions.label: Post-bootstrap 95% confidence interval
metricDefinitions.definition: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles from 10,000 bootstrap samples over posts.

metricDefinitions.label: Order consistency
metricDefinitions.definition: Share of complete post groups where the same actual model wins in both presentation orders.

evidenceFlow.title: Coverage
evidenceFlow.detail: 2,986 of 3,000 unique calls succeeded. Fourteen were rejected by provider content inspection on both the initial and retry runs. The append-only log retains 28 historical error rows across those two attempts.

evidenceFlow.title: Test command
evidenceFlow.detail: PYTHONPATH=. .conda/bin/pytest -q returned 8 passed on the server environment.
